subject: Error produced by RunMI when using lavaan function

messages.author: 43e935fd27d50228
messages.subject: Error produced by RunMI when using lavaan function
parts:
Hi all, 

I am attempting to fit a univariate latent change score model using runMI() and lavaan.mi() and I keep getting the following error:

Error in if (sum(converged.l) < 2) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I am using mice for imputation and I am estimating with MLR.  I have used the same imputed data and runMI() for many other latent growth models and parallel process models without any issues. The model I am fitting runs with lavaan() using FIML.  It fits well. 

Any ideas on how to resolve this error? Any other info needed?

Also, apologies if it is not appropriate to post about SemTools functions in this group.  I can't seem to locate a Semtools forum that has any activity. 

Thanks, 
Clint

messages.subject: Re: Error produced by RunMI when using lavaan function
parts:
Thanks for the quick reply. 

I am new to R, Lavaan, and posting in forums about these topics, so I apologize in advance if I am not replying with what you need. 

These are the functions I have tried: 

runMI(clas.mod1, data=ptpspc.data.mice, chi="all", fun="lavaan", estimator="MLR")
lavaan.mi(clas.mod1, data=ptpspc.data.mice, chi="all", estimator="MLR") 

Both produce the same error.  As you'll see, I imputed the data outside of this function.  Might this be the issue?  I have run dozens of different (simpler) models in the same manner.

The imputation functions are:

mice.data <- mice(ptpspc.data, m = 20, seed=12345, defaultMethod = c("pmm","logreg","polyreg","polr"), pred = pred.import, vis = "monotone")

m <- mice.data$m 
ptpspc.data.mice <- NULL #create empty list
for (i in 1:m) {
  ptpspc.data.mice[[i]] <- complete(x=mice.data, action=i, include=FALSE)
}

The FIML call that does not produce an error is:

lavaan(clas.mod1, data=ptpspc.data, estimator="MLR", missing="fiml") 

Thanks!
Clint

messages.author: 43e935fd27d50228
messages.subject: Re: Error produced by RunMI when using lavaan function
parts:
Hi Alex, 

The problem appears to be solved. 

My original model syntax contained the following...

#Beta proportions 
D2 ~ B*L1
D3 ~ B*L2
D4 ~ B*L3

#Latent intercept / slope loadings
I =~ 1*L1 
S =~ A*D2 + A*D3 + A*D4

#constraints
A == 1
B == 0


I changed it to...

#Beta proportions 
D2 ~ 0*L1
D3 ~ 0*L2
D4 ~ 0*L3

#Latent intercept / slope loadings
I =~ 1*L1 
S =~ 1*D2 + 1*D3 + 1*D4


....and runMI() ran normally, without errors


Since I have such little experience with lavaan, I am not sure if I should have not used "==" in this way,  or if it is something that causes an error with RunMI.

Thanks for your help and sorry to bother you all with something so simple. 

Thanks, 
Clint
